basic_profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
basic_profile.profile_summary: Full Stack Web Developer and final-year Information Technology undergraduate with hands-on experience across React.js, Node.js, Spring Boot, and REST API development, with practical exposure to AI and LLM-based applications.

education.institution: Prof. Dr. N. D. Patil Vidyalaya

professional_profile.short_term_goal: Get a software development role where I can strengthen my Java, full-stack, AI and problem-solving skills while working on real-world projects.
professional_profile.long_term_goal: In the next five years, I see myself becoming a significant contributor to the organization and gradually taking on leadership responsibilities based on my skills and experience. I want to remain adaptable because technology, market requirements and business models continue to change. I want to continuously learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements so that I can continue contributing effectively to the organization.
professional_profile.why_it: I became interested in technology during the holidays after my 10th board examination. I was curious about how websites and applications work, so I started exploring HTML and C programming. I enjoyed learning how software is built, which motivated me to pursue a Diploma in Information Technology and later continue with my Bachelor's degree in Information Technology.
professional_profile.why_software_development: I enjoy solving problems through code and building applications that can solve practical problems. During my academic projects, internships and personal projects, I realized that I enjoy turning an idea or requirement into a working application. That interest motivates me to pursue software development as a career.
professional_profile.motivation: I feel motivated when I learn something new and see progress in my work. Completing challenging tasks successfully and continuously improving my skills motivates me to perform better every day.
professional_profile.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my future self. I imagine where I want to be in five years and work daily to reach that goal.

strengths.name: Adaptability
strengths.description: During a semester project, the team decided to switch the frontend technology to React because it offered better component reusability and scalability. Although I had limited React experience at that time, I spent extra time learning it through documentation and practice and successfully completed my part on time.
strengths.example: Learning and adapting to React when the project requirements changed.

strengths.name: Consistency and dedication
strengths.description: Whenever I take responsibility for a task, I remain committed until it is completed successfully. I regularly follow a schedule during project development and placement preparation and continue working even when tasks become difficult.
strengths.example: Maintaining consistent effort during project development and placement preparation.

strengths.name: Willingness to learn
strengths.description: When I encounter a technology that I have not worked with before, I try to understand it through documentation, practice and projects.
strengths.example: While learning AI Engineering, I started with LLM fundamentals and gradually explored structured outputs, prompt engineering and prompt chaining, then applied these concepts in projects.

hr_profile.self_introduction: My name is Snehal Krushna Bandal. I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology from Atharva College of Engineering, Mumbai, with a CGPA of 9.13 till the latest semester. I completed my Diploma in Information Technology from Government Polytechnic Awasari with 91.2%. During my diploma and engineering journey, I developed a strong foundation in programming and web development. I gained knowledge of Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, and MongoDB through academics, internships, personal projects, and hands-on projects. Apart from academics, I am an active open-source contributor and have contributed to GirlScript Summer of Code 2026. I was also part of teams selected for Smart India Hackathon in 2025 and 2026. I genuinely enjoy learning and adapting, and that curiosity pushes me to improve every day. I hope to join a company where I can continue learning, contribute my skills and work on real-world projects.

weakness.primary: Earlier, I used to feel nervous while speaking in formal situations and in front of large audiences. To overcome this, I started participating in project presentations, technical events and student activities. These experiences have improved my confidence, and I continue working on becoming a better communicator.
weakness.alternative: I sometimes spend too much time trying to make my work perfect.

hr_profile.how_i_handle_pressure: I try to stay calm, break the work into smaller tasks and prioritize the most important work first.
hr_profile.how_i_handle_deadlines: I divide the task into smaller parts, prioritize them and track my progress so that I can complete the important work before the deadline.
hr_profile.teamwork_style: I communicate with team members, divide responsibilities according to our strengths and discuss problems together when someone gets stuck. I have also had opportunities to lead semester project teams during my diploma and B.E. because of my interest in learning, communication and keeping the team together.
hr_profile.failure_and_learning: I see failure as an opportunity to understand what I need to improve. I participated in a hackathon where our idea was not selected in the initial submission round. Instead of being discouraged, I tried to understand where we could improve and worked on those areas. Later, I became part of teams that were selected for Smart India Hackathon in both 2025 and 2026. This taught me that failure can help identify areas for improvement and motivate us to perform better.
hr_profile.conflict_handling: During a semester project, a teammate and I had different opinions about which database to use. Instead of continuing the disagreement, we decided to build small applications using both technologies and compare them. After exploring both options, we realized that my teammate's suggestion was more suitable for the project, so we decided to use that database. This taught me that I may not always be right and that understanding another person's perspective and evaluating ideas objectively is important.
biggest_achievement: Achieved 1st rank in the 10th board examination at my school and tuition.
Was part of teams selected for Smart India Hackathon in both 2025 and 2026.
hr_profile.biggest_challenge: During a semester project, I had a disagreement with a teammate about which database to use. We built small applications using both technologies and compared them. After evaluating both options, we realized that my teammate's suggestion was more suitable, so we selected that database. This taught me the importance of considering another person's perspective and understanding that I may not always be right.
hr_profile.why_should_company_consider_me: I believe I can contribute through my technical skills, willingness to learn, adaptability and consistent approach to work. I have built projects using Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, databases, REST APIs and AI technologies, and I have gained practical experience through internships and academic projects. I can adapt when requirements or technologies change and I am comfortable learning technologies that I have not worked with before. I have worked on team projects, participated in hackathons, contributed to open-source projects and taken responsibilities within student activities. As a fresher, I know that I still have a lot to learn, and I am willing to learn from experienced professionals, take responsibility, continuously improve my skills and contribute to real-world projects.

projects.name: AI-Powered Fitness Tracking System
projects.short_description: A full-stack fitness tracking application that allows users to securely track fitness activities and receive AI-generated personalized fitness recommendations.
projects.problem: Users need a secure and convenient way to track fitness activities and receive personalized recommendations based on their fitness data.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack fitness tracking application with microservices, secure authentication, event-driven communication and AI-generated fitness recommendations.
projects.role: Developed the full-stack application and worked on microservices architecture, REST APIs, authentication, event-driven communication, database integration and AI recommendation functionality.
solutions: Used Spring Cloud Gateway for centralized API routing
Used Apache Kafka for event-driven communication

projects.name: LegalLens
projects.short_description: An AI-assisted platform designed to help inspectors analyze packaged products, extract label information, check compliance rules and generate digital inspection reports.
projects.problem: Checking packaged commodities for Legal Metrology compliance can require inspectors to manually examine product packaging and verify required declarations.
projects.solution: Built an AI-assisted inspection platform that combines image scanning, OCR, AI analysis, rule-based validation, evidence management and digital reporting.
projects.role: Worked on the demo full-stack application, website structure, React inspector interface, FastAPI backend APIs, compliance workflow, evidence management and digital report generation.
challenges: Different fonts, orientations, layouts and image quality
Different packaging layouts and declaration formats
Keeping images, extracted information and compliance results associated with the correct inspection
solutions: Used OCR pipelines for text extraction
Combined OCR, AI analysis and rule-based validation
Used FastAPI REST APIs to connect frontend, AI/OCR services, database and reporting workflow
Used YOLO-based image analysis where visual detection was required

projects.name: AI Resume Screening System
projects.short_description: An AI-powered recruitment system that analyzes job descriptions and multiple resumes to identify matching and missing skills and evaluate candidate-job compatibility.
projects.problem: Recruiters may need to review multiple resumes against a job description, which can be time-consuming.
projects.solution: Built an AI-powered resume screening system that parses job descriptions and resumes, extracts structured information, performs semantic matching and generates candidate match scores.
projects.role: Designed and developed the AI resume screening workflow including resume/JD parsing, structured extraction, semantic skill matching and candidate scoring.
challenges: Matching skills based on meaning rather than only exact keywords
Generating structured and consistent LLM responses
solutions: Used prompt engineering for structured extraction

projects.name: Cafe Management System
projects.short_description: A Java-based cafe management application for employee order placement, owner menu management and automated PDF billing.
projects.problem: Cafe owners and employees need a simple system to manage menu, orders and billing efficiently.
projects.solution: Developed a Java application with role-based access, order management, menu management and PDF bill generation.
projects.role: Designed and developed the application including role-based access, order placement, menu management and automated PDF billing.

projects.name: StegoAI — ML-Based Video Steganography System
projects.short_description: A full-stack application that embeds and extracts secret messages in videos using LSB steganography while using machine learning to detect spam content.
projects.problem: Sensitive information may need to be hidden inside video files while preventing unwanted or spam content from being embedded.
projects.solution: Built a React and Flask application using LSB steganography for video message embedding and extraction and a TF-IDF plus Naive Bayes classifier for spam detection.
projects.role: Developed the full-stack application and worked on video steganography, REST APIs, message embedding and extraction, OpenCV integration and machine-learning-based spam classification.
challenges: Connecting React frontend with Flask backend
solutions: Used TF-IDF and Naive Bayes for spam detection
